readme: The build orchestrator's part of settings-sources@1 (framework/schemas/settings-sources.json): settings its pipeline once kept a copy of. Each is stored under one key elsewhere; the pipeline reads it and never stores it again (ALIAS_KEYS in pipeline-core.mjs, migrateSettings() in pipeline.mjs).

sources.label: Sessions per account
sources.meaning: How many sessions one Claude account runs at once: the default for every account, and an account's own number when it has one.
edit: Settings → Plugins → Claude accounts → Job routing → Sessions per account
Builds → Pipeline → Accounts → More sessions / Fewer sessions (an account's own number)
Claude accounts plugin API: POST routing/settings {building}

this plugin's API and commands: POST pipeline/settings {parallelPerAccount} (saved as limits.building), POST pipeline/account {name, parallel} (saved as perAccount.<name>.building); pipeline-settings / pipeline-account over MCP and voice
node deploy/claude-workers.mjs set building=N · pipeline.mjs set parallelPerAccount=N · pipeline.mjs account <name> --parallel N
read: this plugin's API: GET pipeline (accounts[].parallel, settings.parallelPerAccount)

aliases.migration: migrateSettings() in pipeline.mjs → a settings-migrated line in <pipeline dir>/log.jsonl
read last by loadSettings() in pipeline.mjs; no longer a registered Claude setting

retiredWording: Jobs building at once, per account

sources.label: Launch builds without asking
sources.meaning: New builds go straight to the Queue, without a card asking first.
edit: Settings → Claude → Builds → Launch builds without asking
Claude settings plugin API: PUT settings {"builds.launchWithoutAsking": …}; claude-settings.mjs set builds.launchWithoutAsking=…
read: Claude settings plugin API: GET settings

sources.label: Max launch brief size (bytes)
sources.meaning: A launch brief bigger than this is trimmed.
edit: Settings → Claude → Builds → Max launch brief size (bytes)
Claude settings plugin API: PUT settings {"builds.briefMaxBytes": …}; claude-settings.mjs set builds.briefMaxBytes=…
read: Claude settings plugin API: GET settings
